lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Rodrigo Luiz | Lesson 31 -- Grand Finale (Final Review)

listenings.text: Good morning, everybody, and welcome to the global forum. Today we have three parts. First, the KPIs of each plant. Next, a discussion about the new purchasing plan. Finally, your questions. Brazil is first today. Rodrigo, you have five minutes. The floor is yours.

Hi Rodrigo, it's Tom. Great job at the forum today! Your presentation was clear, and your answer to Pierre was perfect. When you come to New York, let's have dinner in Brooklyn. I know a great pizza place. Talk soon!

extra_audio.text: Rodrigo joined the global forum. First, he introduced himself and his team. Next, he presented three KPIs with a chart. Then he gave his opinion about the purchasing plan. Pierre asked a difficult question, and Rodrigo said: let me check and come back to you. At the end, Claire said: great job, Rodrigo.
